mapper.select: SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM weekly_goal wg WHERE wg.user_id = #{userId} AND wg.achieved = 1 ) AS achievements, ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ll.course_id) FROM learning_lesson ll JOIN ( SELECT user_id, course_id, MAX(accuracy) AS max_accuracy FROM assessment_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id, course_id ) ar ON ar.user_id = ll.user_id AND ar.course_id = ll.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND ll.status = 2 AND ar.max_accuracy >= 0.8 ) AS certificates

SELECT CASE WHEN COALESCE(SUM(cs.total_sections), 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(SUM(ll.learned_sections), 0) * 100 / SUM(cs.total_sections)) END FROM learning_lesson ll JOIN course c ON ll.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(id) AS total_sections FROM course_section GROUP BY course_id ) cs ON c.id = cs.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT c.id, c.name AS title, NULL AS subtitle, i.name AS instructor, c.cover_url AS image, c.rating, c.review_count AS reviewCount, COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) AS learnedSections, COALESCE(cs.total_sections, 0) AS totalSections, CASE WHEN COALESCE(cs.total_sections, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE FLOOR(COALESCE(ll.learned_sections, 0) * 100 / cs.total_sections) END AS progress, 'IN_PROGRESS' AS status, ll.latest_section_id AS latestSectionId FROM learning_lesson ll JOIN course c ON ll.course_id = c.id LEFT JOIN instructor i ON c.instructor_id = i.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT course_id, COUNT(id) AS total_sections FROM course_section GROUP BY course_id ) cs ON c.id = cs.course_id WHERE ll.user_id = #{userId} AND ll.status = 1 ORDER BY ll.latest_learn_time DESC, ll.id DESC LIMIT 2
